value.rationale: The source documents a qualitative high-rate transition of exit preferences but does not quantify the competition window or its successful-duration fluctuations. The natural distance-mismatch scale 1/q is resolved into a logistic side law, an independent central-limit duration fluctuation, a global all-rate analytic Bessel approximation bound, and a sharp exponentially small corner-interference coefficient. These are meaningful physically interpretable quantities for a two-outcome search with control of the reset point, not an arbitrary narrow invariant.
